of our Corporate Responsibility program. Our pay and promotion metrics are evaluated by Secretariat 
Economists, Inc. We engaged an external third-party to perform a limited assurance engagement over 
select GHG emissions metrics for the year ended January 29, 2023. For more information, please see the 
Report of Independent Accountants and NVIDIA’s management assertion available here.
